initialExam.title: HAL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026
initialExam.description: HAL recruits Diploma Technicians, ITI Technicians, Security Guards, and Firemen for aircraft manufacturing, MRO, and defence aviation operations. 144 vacancies notified.
initialExam.eligibility: Diploma in Engineering / ITI in relevant trade / 10th pass for Security/Fireman
initialExam.syllabus: Technical knowledge based on Diploma/ITI syllabus. General Aptitude, Reasoning, English, General Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test (objective) + Skill Test. Written: 100 questions, 100 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Skill Test / Physical Test → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Technician in aircraft manufacturing, assembly, testing, and maintenance at HAL divisions
initialExam.careerGrowth: Technician → Senior Technician → Supervisor → Manager (through internal promotions).
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit hal-india.co.in 2. Register online 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: IDA Pay Scale for Non-Executive posts

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Canteen, Transport, Provident Fund, Gratuity

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
